rex_fm_001.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_001.text: Don't touch the merchandise until you've paid. Basic rule. You look like you've survived a few things — what do you need?

choices.text: I'm looking to trade. What do you have?
I saw the posting. The silo job. What's the rate?
[Barter 40] I know what things are worth out here. Don't try to gouge me.
That signal everyone's nervous about — you've scouted the wastes. Where's it coming from?

rex_fm_002a.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_002a.text: Ammo, medical basics, a couple of weapons I liberated from people who no longer needed them. Caps or trade. I don't do credit. Go on — look.

rex_fm_002b.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_002b.text: The Covenant has at least a squad in there. Maybe more. Rate is three hundred caps plus a ten percent cut of whatever you pull out. Non-negotiable — I've done the scouting already.

rex_fm_003_silo.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_003_silo.text: One more thing. Whatever that signal is — somebody wants it kept quiet. I've had two people ask me not to talk about it in the last week. That tells me it's worth finding.

rex_fm_002c_pass.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_002c_pass.text: *studies you* You've been around. Fair enough. Union discount — fifteen percent off posted prices. Don't tell anyone. Here's the stock.

rex_fm_002c_fail.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_002c_fail.text: Posted prices are what they are. You want it, pay for it. You don't, walk on. Take a look.

rex_fm_signal_origin.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_signal_origin.text: ...You didn't hear it from me. The old Silo Complex, east-northeast past the Scrapfield. The Covenant's been crawling all over it for weeks. That's where your radio ghost lives. Whatever you do with that, leave my name out of it.

rex_tr_001.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_tr_001.text: Back again. What do you need?

choices.text: The signal — where did you say it's coming from?
The silo job — tell me the rate again.

rex_tr_trade.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_tr_trade.text: Caps or trade. Same rules as always.

rex_tr_signal_origin.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_tr_signal_origin.text: The old Silo Complex, east-northeast past the Scrapfield. Covenant territory now. Like I said — my name stays out of it.

rex_tr_silo.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_tr_silo.text: Three hundred caps plus ten percent of the haul. The Covenant's still squatting in there — that price doesn't move.

rex_tr_bye.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_tr_bye.text: Then don't touch the merchandise on your way out.
